original.hero:
Use case: illustration-story. Create one original black-and-white three-panel stick-figure comic for the GitHub README of a Chinese local PDF study app, Zhijian. The user loves Randall Munroe/xkcd: evoke that spare hand-drawn black ink stick-figure visual language and deadpan nerd humor. Original situation, not any existing strip. White #ffffff background, thin slightly irregular black pen strokes, empty round heads, stick bodies and limbs, tiny simple laptop and desk, absurdly tall stack of documents, immense negative space. NO color, grey shading, paper textures, photorealism, cute mascots, marketing icons, corporate illustration, polished geometric vector art, logos or artist signature. Extra-wide horizontal strip about 3:1, three equal panels separated by two short uneven vertical lines, clean large Chinese dialogue near the top with simple pointer strokes (no bubble shapes), large enough to read at 900px display width. Very limited background detail. Keep characters unmistakable and expressive through posture only.
Panel 1 left: seated stick student at laptop, a small pile of papers beside them. Dialogue EXACTLY: “我先把课件整理一下。”
Panel 2 middle: same student hunched over laptop, multiple tiny window rectangles overlapping above the screen, clock on plain wall. Dialogue EXACTLY: “我再查一个知识点。”
Panel 3 right: standing visitor on left asks EXACTLY: “复习得怎么样？” Seated student on right at laptop replies EXACTLY in two lines: “我已经熟练掌握了\n切换窗口。” Pointer lines must clearly identify speakers.
No large headline, no footer caption, no extra words, no numbered steps. The punchline is the last dialogue. Consistent pen line weight. Compose all text safely within generous margins. Save a wide horizontal comic, not square.

Use case: illustration-story. Create one original black-and-white three-panel stick-figure comic for the GitHub README of a Chinese local PDF study app. Match spare hand-drawn black ink stick figures and deadpan humor familiar from Randall Munroe/xkcd, original scene only. White #ffffff, thin uneven black pen strokes, empty round heads with no eyes/faces, stick limbs, simple desk laptop and paper props, lots of whitespace. Wide horizontal three-panel strip about 3:1. Two short irregular vertical panel separators. Big clear simplified Chinese hand-lettered dialogue near top, simple pointer strokes, no speech bubbles. NO color, textures, shadows, gray fills, decorative cards, glossy artwork, artist signature or logo.
Panel 1: stick student at desk deleting unwanted pages, a ridiculously taller stack of discarded blank sheets than the small remaining stack. Say EXACTLY: “删掉重复的封面。” Small handwritten label under discarded pile EXACTLY: “封面”
Panel 2: same student leaning toward laptop, marks one short passage on a document and a little question mark beside it. Say EXACTLY: “这段没懂，先记下来。”
Panel 3: same student points at their laptop, which has a tiny page column and chat column in one rectangular screen. Another stick figure stands next to them. Student says EXACTLY: “就在原文旁边问。” Visitor says EXACTLY: “这次终于在复习了。”
No headline, no subtitle, no labels beyond those specified, no step numbers. All text large and legible at 900px displayed width. Same sparse editorial comic mood as a thoughtful programmer's webcomic, not a marketing infographic.

No other text. Wide 3:1 image, white background, no color. Do not crop text or characters. Keep the deadpan humor.

No colors, textures, gray fills, polished vector graphics, branding or signatures. Large clear simplified Chinese dialogue EXACTLY "再复制一点上下文给 AI。" In foreground an inset close view of a keyboard with clearly labeled keys "Ctrl" "C" "V" showing worn-out cracks; simple hand-drawn pointer from copy/paste activity to keys. Visitor says EXACTLY "复习有什么进展？" Student replies EXACTLY "Ctrl、C、V 先撑不住了。" Large legible Chinese placed with ample whitespace and short pointer lines identifying speakers. 2 panels divided by one uneven black vertical line; no other text or explanatory captions. Keyboard gag must be visually unambiguous, even without words.
